title: Perspective API
description: A client-side API framework for managing and extending Minecraft's camera perspectives.

# Perspective API ![API version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/Leawind/Perspective-API?label=API&color=818181) [![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/LIqveQm1?style=flat&logo=modrinth&color=17B85A&cacheSeconds=3600&label=Modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/perspective-api) [![CurseForge Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1575322?style=flat&logo=curseforge&color=F1643%5E&cacheSeconds=3600&label=CurseForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/perspective-api)
Perspective API is a client-side library that empowers other mods to provide smoother, more flexible, and immersive camera experiences. Even when installed alone, it enhances the vanilla game by adding **smooth transition animations** to perspective switches. > **Note:** While this API provides immediate quality-of-life improvements for vanilla perspective switching, it is primarily designed as a foundation for advanced perspective mods. Currently, there are no public mods that utilize this API yet, but it is ready for developers to build upon!
